review: The coordinating agent reviewed the 24 original poses and V2 transition sheet: one consistent black-ink whale, stable eye and mouth, connected torso and fins, no V1 gray tail afterimages.
Every original ImageGen anchor remains pixel-identical in the encoded animation; only the 72 in-between frames are interpolated.
Final compiled-component screenshots were inspected at desktop and 390 px mobile sizes; the whale is complete and clearly visible against the static pale ocean stage.

Seven built-bundle browser checks passed: normal native WebP movement, system and in-product PNG reduced-motion behavior, dark/light and narrow layouts, planned features and PNG export. The in-product PNG stayed pixel-identical over 450 ms before playback resumed.
Actual upgraded DSH Shell verification is performed by the coordinating task after this component-level acceptance.
acceptedLimitations: At an enlarged 288 px transition view, interpolated contour edges are slightly harder than the untouched ImageGen anchors.
